name: Priya Sharma
bio:
Priya's motorsport journey began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the engineering labs of the Indian Institute of Technology. After earning her degree, she dedicated several years to perfecting manufacturing processes within the automotive industry. Her meticulous attention to detail and innate understanding of mechanical systems soon led her to motorsport, where she saw the opportunity to elevate performance through rigorous quality control.

At Lechner Racing, Priya is known for her eagle eye and her commitment to upholding the highest standards. She fosters a collaborative environment where every team member understands the critical role they play in the quality assurance process. Her flexible nature and drive for excellence ensure that every component meets the rigorous demands of competitive racing. Priya is determined to push the boundaries of quality in motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly braided, often tied in a bun
physical.description: Priya has a warm, intelligent face, framed by dark hair and expressive eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Insists on double-checking critical components herself, no matter how busy she is.
Starts her day with a cup of masala chai, brewed using a traditional recipe.
